sloka: प्रस्तराः पुष्पशबला नभस्तारागणैरिव ।नन्दनं हि यथेन्द्रस्य ब्राह्मं चैत्ररथं यथा ।तथाभूतं हि रामस्य काननं सन्निवेशनम् ।। ७.४२.१५ ॥
transliteration: prastarāḥ puṣpaśabalā nabhastārāgaṇairiva ।nandanaṁ hi yathendrasya brāhmaṁ caitrarathaṁ yathā ।tathābhūtaṁ hi rāmasya kānanaṁ sanniveśanam ।। 7.42.15 ॥

translations.english: The rock surfaces were variegated with flowers, resembling the sky adorned with clusters of stars, and indeed, Rama's garden and dwelling were as magnificent as Indra's Nandana or Kubera's Chaitraratha.
